about.title: About Crisistance
about.description: We help small businesses prepare for, respond to, and recover from crises with purpose-built solutions that fit your needs and budget.
about.missionP1: Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, yet they often lack the resources for comprehensive crisis management. We bridge that gap by providing enterprise-level crisis preparedness and response capabilities at a scale and price point that works for small business owners.
about.missionP2: Our approach combines proven methodologies with practical implementation, ensuring your business can weather any storm and emerge stronger.

purposeDriven.title: Purpose-Driven
purposeDriven.description: Every solution is designed with small business realities in mind.

expertTeam.title: Expert Team
expertTeam.description: Crisis management professionals with real-world experience.

provenResults.title: Proven Results
provenResults.description: Track record of helping businesses survive and thrive through crises.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: We evaluate your business vulnerabilities, resources, and specific risk profile to understand your unique needs.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Together, we develop comprehensive crisis management plans tailored to your business size, industry, and budget constraints.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: Your business is prepared with actionable plans, ongoing monitoring, and rapid response capabilities when crises occur.

about.trustedP1: Our team brings decades of combined experience in crisis management, business continuity, and small business operations. We understand both the theory and the practical realities of keeping a small business running during turbulent times.
about.trustedP2: From family-owned restaurants to growing tech startups, we've helped businesses across industries prepare for and navigate through their most challenging moments.
